metadata.title: test: speed up slow docker-entrypoint and sensitive-logging tests
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

Two CI test-runtime wins from analyzing the pytest `--durations` output:

- **`test_install_plugin_requirements_retries_three_times_then_fails`**: ~4.2s → ~0.04s. The test forces three pip failures, and `docker-entrypoint.sh` slept 2s between retries. Made the delay configurable via `PLUGIN_REQUIREMENTS_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS` (default `2`, preserving production behavior), and the test sets it to `0`.
- **`test_runtime_logger_calls_do_not_embed_sensitive_values`**: ~3.7s → ~0.6s. The scan was `ast.parse()`-ing every `mcpgateway/**/*.py` file containing `logger.` (~150 files). Added a cheap substring pre-filter so only files that mention a sensitive identifier (`token`, `password`, `credentials`, etc.) are parsed.

Also audited the rest of `tests/` for similar patterns. Remaining `asyncio.sleep(N)` calls in unit tests are inside mock coroutines that get cancelled by the test harness (idiomatic cancellation/timeout pattern), and the other `rglob("*.py")` scan in `test_policies.py` is narrowly scoped to the framework directory.

## Test plan

- [x] `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_docker_entrypoint.py` — 5 passed, retry test at 0.04s
- [x] `uv run pytest tests/security/test_input_validation.py::TestSensitiveLoggingRegressions` — 5 passed, scan test at 0.56s
- [x] Production default preserved: `sleep 2` still applies when `PLUGIN_REQUIREMENTS_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS` is unset

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: `PLUGIN_REQUIREMENTS_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS` is user-controlled, and this script runs with `set -euo pipefail`. If the env var is set to a non-numeric value (or a negative), `sleep "${retry_delay}"` will error and terminate the entrypoint, potentially masking the real pip failure. Consider validating `retry_delay` (numeric and >= 0) and either falling back to the default (2s) with a warning or emitting a clear error message before exiting.

commits.message:
test: speed up docker-entrypoint retry and sensitive-logging scan tests

- docker-entrypoint.sh: make plugin requirements retry delay configurable
  via PLUGIN_REQUIREMENTS_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS (default 2s); test sets 0
  to avoid waiting 4s for the retry-exhaustion path.
- tests/security/test_input_validation.py: add text-level pre-filter so
  the runtime logger scan only ast.parse() files that could plausibly
  contain a sensitive identifier.

Cuts test_install_plugin_requirements_retries_three_times_then_fails
from ~4.2s to ~0.04s and
test_runtime_logger_calls_do_not_embed_sensitive_values from ~3.7s to
~0.6s in CI.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
fix(entrypoint): validate PLUGIN_REQUIREMENTS_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS

A non-numeric or negative value would cause `sleep` to fail under
`set -euo pipefail`, masking the real pip install failure. Validate
the env var up front and fall back to the 2s default with a warning
if it is not a non-negative number. Adds a regression test covering
the invalid-value path.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
